visualCharacteristics: Two-column side-by-side layout on a solid grey container with padding. Image on the left, text content (eyebrow label, heading, description, CTA) on the right. Stacks to a single column on small screens.
contentPattern: One row with two cells: first cell holds the image, second cell holds the text content (eyebrow, heading, description, single CTA link).
usage: Featured article or promo with an image beside a block of text and a call-to-action.
